summary: American Rebel Holdings filed a Form 8-K reporting three financing and capital-structure actions. On September 23, 2026, $100,000 was released from a Lakeside Bank deposit account control agreement tied to a June 2025 Streeterville secured note. On October 2, 2026, Horberg Enterprises exchanged 10,800 Series D preferred shares for 81 Series E preferred shares valued at $81,000, then swapped those Series E shares for 1,756,507 common shares. An October 5, 2026 Streeterville note exchange is also referenced. The filing contains no acquisition, divestiture, tender, or going-private terms; watch preferred-to-common dilution and note conversion overhang.
